name: R-Delta Trace
description: R-Delta Trace, the Racelink overlay, as a standalone overlay.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: The target lap the current one is compared with along the whole lap.

settings.label: Minimum range (s)
settings.description: The minimum vertical range of the trace, in seconds.

settings.label: Maximum range (s)
settings.description: The maximum vertical range of the trace, in seconds.

settings.label: Lap reset delay (s)
settings.description: How many seconds after the start/finish line the completed lap trace stays.

settings.label: Source
settings.description: The previous lap trace over the histogram, measured against the same target lap.

settings.label: Show corner numbers
settings.description: Adds corner markers and labels to the trace so you can see where each corner is. When the track corners are unknown, sectors are shown instead.

settings.label: Markers
settings.description: For the line and tick display.

settings.label: Show segment delta
settings.description: Splits the lap into corners and straights and shows each segment’s delta as a coloured bar: red is a loss, green a gain.

settings.label: Timing mode

options.label: Corner with the straight after it

settings.description: When the track corners are unknown, sectors serve as segments.

settings.label: Show the Weak Spot panel
settings.description: The segment where you lost the most time on the previous lap: improving it gains the most.

settings.label: Segment map
settings.description: The segment on the track map. Needs the track geometry (iRacing).

settings.label: Show the live delta
settings.description: Your current delta on this segment: whether it got better.

settings.label: Show the Delta Trace panel
settings.description: When off, only the Weak Spot panel shows.
